content.title: EGA, Century Aluminum enters joint development agreement
content.summary: Emirates Global Aluminium and Century Aluminum (CENX) Company entered into a joint development agreement to build the first new primary aluminum production plant in the United States since 1980. Under the joint development agreement, EGA will own 60 percent of the joint venture, with Century owning the remaining 40 percent. content.title: Century Aluminum Planned Its Own Smelter. Now, It’s Working With a Competitor Instead.
content.summary: Century Aluminum is abandoning plans to build a new smelter on its own and joining up with a Dubai-based company to develop one in Oklahoma.  Emirates Global Aluminum last year said it planned to build the company’s first U.S. smelter near Tulsa.  Under the revised plan, Century Aluminum would take a 40% stake in the venture, with Emirates Global Aluminum owning the remaining 60%.
